messages:
jamie: Heads up — embeds in eu1 are returning 503s from ~03:12 UTC. Repro on canary and some user traffic. Suspect kvcache thrash. Planning an urgent hotfix (image bump) and need fast approvals.
sam: Looks like `kvcache` OOM and eviction spikes on older LRU behavior. Patch ready: changes `--cache-ttl` to 120s and adds a small heap guard.
maya: Change window still open til 04:00 UTC in eu1, but we need ops signoff for expedited push.
lina: Oncall here. I can approve during the window if canary is limited and auto-rollback is enabled. Tagging infra for network sanity check.
chris: +1 from infra side — small config change only. Recommend canary 5% then ramp if healthy.
release-manager: Please include a short release note blurb and pin strategy. I can sign off for expedited approval.
deploybot: deploybot: Received deploy request from jamie
```
/deploy --service=embeds --image=redwood/embeds:v1.2.4-rc1 --region=eu1 --canary=5% --auto-rollback=on
```
ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduling canary in eu1. Canary window 3m. Monitoring hooks active.
sam: Running quick staging smoke with v1.2.4-rc1 — embedding latency fine, kv eviction looks stable.
jamie: Release notes draft: "embeds: fix kvcache eviction spike in high-concurrency workloads; bump cache TTL and add heap guard. Patch rolling to eu1 canary." https://internal.redwood/release-notes/embeds/1.2.4-rc1
release-manager: Approved. Pinning v1.2.4-rc1 for 2h emergency window. :rocket:
deploybot: Canary rollout started: 1/5 succeeded, 2/5 transient failures observed — autoscaling retried.
chris: Observed transient fail on one AZ, looks like a node reboot. Ops investigating, but canary still within expected variance.
ops-bot: Canary completed: 5/5 healthy. Initiating gradual traffic shift to new image. Auto-rollback disabled per release-manager pin.
maya: Monitoring dashboards: error rate down to baseline, p95 latency stable. :thumbsup:
sam: Post-deploy smoke passed. Kvcache evictions dropped ~90% on canary.
jamie: Good job. Will monitor 30m and then cut a small release note and close thread. If anything regresses we rollback to v1.2.3 (pinned image noted in deploybot logs).
lina: Acknowledged. Keeping oncall watch for next 30m.
chris: Filing a short postmortem link once we verify root cause. Thanks all.
release-manager: Leaving a note: quick patch approved and pinned; update release tracker with follow-up action items. :white_check_mark:
